layers.text: Class: one bold item sprite for a browser favicon in the style of a cute chunky 16x16 fantasy dungeon tileset, drawn on a 32x32 canvas so it halves cleanly to 16x16: a single simple object with a big clear silhouette built from 2x2 pixel blocks, no 1-pixel-thin details, a single dark purple outline #332745 all around so it reads on both a white and a near-black browser tab, flat colours with one shade step, light from the upper left, saturated mid-tone colours, 3-5 colours, no dithering, no anti-aliasing, the object fills most of the canvas with 1 pixel of margin and floats alone on a transparent background.

Subject: a chunky golden dungeon key lying diagonally from the bottom left to the top right: a big round ring bow with a round hole at the top right, a thick short shaft, and a bit with two square teeth at the bottom left; gold #ffe250 with orange-gold #ffbd51 shade on the lower right and a cream #fcfff1 glint on the upper left of the ring.
